_description:
Season Pass, Battle Pass and daily reward windows -> server/data/tickets.json (roadmap Phase 7).

Sources:
  - The login bundle in the recording (server/data/login.json, 2026-10-15): SeasonPassStatusCommand (point and uridium costs of 90 levels,
    season name and image), SeasonPassRewardInfoCommand (free, Gold and Extra Gold rewards), SeasonPassMissionInfoCommand
    (33 quests: QuestType 3 daily, 6 weekly, 9 seasonal; status 2 = requires Gold Pass), BattlePassInfoCommand (28
    quests of Halloween 2026), BattlePassKeyExchangeInfoCommand (51 key exchange rewards), MiniClientRewardInfoCommand (15 daily rewards),
    MonthlyDeluxeInfoCommand (28 daily rewards), EventUnityClientRewardQuestCommand (7 days, 3 quests per day).
  - The Battle Pass XML on the CDN (server/cdn/xml/events/battlepass/pass_*.xml): reward per quest (questReward) and key (bpReward).
  - tools/tickets_wiki.json (ETK1; the current pages of darkorbitwiki, where they conflict with the client and recording, the client and recording win): for the Battle Passes other than Immortal
    Union (Galactic Strife, Gauntlet of Plutus, Hitac Assault, Mimesis Mutiny, Protegit Pandemonium,
    Frozen Labyrinth, Treacherous Domain, Astral Ascension, Space Cup) the quest ids (the client's quest_title ids), objectives,
    rewards, keys and the per-pass key exchange table; Immortal Union's objectives (rewards and keys from the official XML);
    the Season Pass daily/weekly quest pool (the wiki's 48 + 50 rows), season calendar and renewal steps; Mini Client calendars.
    The client builds the quest text itself from the condition type (textKeyFoundation is empty), so conditions are written from the client's condition types.
  - The quantities of Battle Pass package rewards are from the client's English tooltip texts (window_objectives_bp_ttip_questReward-*).
Generated by: tools/tickets.py.

season.name: sp_season-name_1
season._images: The season's Season Pass image (marketingImage): those found on the official CDN do_img/global/events/seasonPass/ (scanned 2026-10-30; the month name is short in some seasons, long in others). The image for 2023-05 and 2023-08 is not on the CDN: the recording's visual

halloween.source: recording (login bundle) and the official CDN XML

galactic_strife.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/galactic-strife; 26 objectives, 176 Battle Keys
galactic_strife.adaptation: In the real game 4-1..4-4 are PvP: the "destroy players / damage players" objectives use the PvE equivalent in single-player (kill Deadly Battleray on 4-1..4-4; NPC damage); EMP-01, Cloak CPU, taking damage and distance on maps 4-1..4-4.

plutus.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/gauntlet-of-plutus; 27 objectives, 167 Battle Keys
plutus.adaptation: Plutus objectives as in the wiki (Easy maps 450-455 and Normal maps 410-415). The "First Face" title does not exist in the client: id 500541 (Blast It!) in the same slot.

hitac.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/hitac-assault; 26 objectives, 171 Battle Keys
hitac.adaptation: Hitac 2.0/2.5 and Minion 2.0/2.5 damage from roaming mother ships (hitac.gezgin). The "Last Lap" title does not exist in the client: the pass's last id is 500362 (Exhaustion).

immortal_union.source: official CDN XML (rewards, keys); conditions and objectives from the wiki
immortal_union.adaptation: Rewards and keys from the official XML (agrees with the wiki on 12/20 keys; the XML wins); conditions and objectives from the wiki. "Damage any Players" is PvP: NPC damage. The wiki's "Complete 15 and 20 objectives" rows are 500452 and 500601 in the XML.

mimesis_mutiny.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/mimesis-mutiny; 27 objectives, 159 Battle Keys
mimesis_mutiny.adaptation: No event for Escort Score points: NPC damage on escort maps. Last objective 500382 (Trick or Treat; the wiki gives the same name).

protegit.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/protegit-pandemonium; 25 objectives, 157 Battle Keys
protegit.adaptation: The wiki's 25 objectives; Chaos Alien CPUs via the combat_items.alien_cpu ammo event.

labyrinth.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/winter-event; 33 objectives, 184 Battle Keys
labyrinth.adaptation: The wiki's 33 objectives (Complete 20 and 25 Objectives: 500409 and 500410, both "Frozen Labyrinth" on the page). Labyrinth key resource_key_access-flb.

world_boss.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/treacherous-domain; 22 objectives, 147 Battle Keys
world_boss.adaptation: 22 of the wiki's 24 objectives: Star Destroyer (15 keys) and Shining Reserve (10 keys) do not exist in client 1.1.115 (no quest_title), not added; total 147 keys (wiki 172). Treacherous Domain map 482.

astral_ascension.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/astral-ascension; 26 objectives, 170 Battle Keys
astral_ascension.adaptation: No event/condition type for wave and score: NPC damage on Astral maps (wave x 2,000,000, score x 10,000; adaptation). Not in the calendar (events.json): the pass takes effect once the event is added.

spacecup.source: written from: darkorbitwiki events/spacecup; 26 objectives, 176 Battle Keys
spacecup.adaptation: Spaceball/PvP objectives use the PvE equivalent (Deadly Battleray on 4-4, NPC damage); Referee-Bot on the event maps (official Turkish forum 135026 / 127757; events.json spacecup). Not in the calendar (events.json): the pass takes effect once the event is added.

plague_mutation.source: written from: official Turkish forum 154610 (Plague Mutation, June 2020) and the client's tooltip texts; 22 objectives, 0 Battle Keys
plague_mutation.adaptation: 22 objectives matched from the forum's table using the client's titles (quest_title_500507-500528); the ticketed rewards are bpReward (no keys, no key exchange). Where the client's tooltip text conflicts with the forum, the client wins (Wipe the Floor: 100 Infection Mines). The Viral Kristallon / Gygerim Overlord objectives use the forum values (their order does not increase by the client's titles: forum's wording)

return_pass._source: client 1.1.115 (UIRecallBattlePassSystem: window recallBattlePass, VIEW request, thresholds cumulative, reward tracks Free/Return/VIP, VIP button payment page RecallPassVip); levels, costs, specialId and quests from the official server recording (2026-10-25); Return track with the Return of Hero quests: board-en 130459; tools/version_115.py
return_pass._adaptation: Daily and weekly quests are those in the recording each day / week (3 + 2 VIP, 5 + 3 VIP); on refresh they are replaced from the Season Pass pool (ids shifted: the same quest progresses separately in the two windows; Gold quests are the VIP quests, experience is Season Pass points). In single-player the player is the returning hero: once the Return track is bound to the veteran in Return of Hero.
